dogecoin.text:
Get the foundations right first.

Don't go buying the latest trending crypto coin $SHIB, $DOGE etc when you don't even have £1,000 to your name.

Skip the foundations, but one day they'll drag you back down.
People do realise $DOGE has an unlimited supply right?😂

There's been a lot of big opportunities in the last year:

- Shorting crude oil (Made £2,200 in half an hour from this😂)
- $GME & $AMC
- Bitcoin
- $TSLA
- $DOGE

These aren't sustainable ways to invest/trade.

But when the next one comes along, make sure you got spare cash.

10,000 $DOGE is mined every minute and has an unlimited supply.

It amazes me that people still buy it😂

Remember when people loved the idea of Bitcoin because it was limited to 21,000,000?
I can't forgive Coinbase for listing $DOGE before $VET🤦‍♂️
